ns2:section.sectionTitle: Poli Prop and the News Media
ns2:section.sectionText: The course examines techniques and processes of political propaganda in a democratic society. It draws from the contemporary theories of influence and persuasion to identify propaganda in the context of journalism, advertising, and public relations, to delineate differences between propaganda and information, and to assess its impact in everyday life. The particular attention is given to the roles of news media as unwitting allies of modern propagandists.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
